info.name: Returns the aggregated historical storage usage of all registered engines over time, optionally with a projection of future storage usage.

params.name: start_date
params.description: Report start date/time. Defaults to first API request.

params.name: end_date
params.description: Report end date/time. Defaults to current time.

params.name: include_projection
params.description: Whether to compute a projection of future storage usage.

params.name: engine_ids
params.description: The list of engine ids to aggregate data for. By default aggregating data for all engines.

params.name: dsource_ids
params.description: The list of dSource ids to aggregate data for. By default aggregating data for all dSources.

params.name: vdb_ids
params.description: The list of VDB ids to aggregate data for. By default aggregating data for all VDBs.

params.name: cdb_ids
params.description: The list of CDB ids to aggregate data for. By default aggregating data for all CDBs.

params.name: vcdb_ids
params.description: The list of VCDB ids to aggregate data for. By default aggregating data for all VCDBs.

items.docs: Returns the aggregated historical storage usage of all registered engines over time, optionally with a projection of future storage usage.

info.name: Returns the historical storage usage by engine over time, optionally with a projection of future storage usage.

params.name: start_date
params.description: Report start date/time. Defaults to first API request.

params.name: end_date
params.description: Report end date/time. Defaults to current time.

params.name: include_projection
params.description: Whether to compute a projection of future storage usage.

params.name: engine_ids
params.description: The list of engine ids to include in the response. By default returning data for all engines.

items.docs: Returns the historical storage usage by engine over time, optionally with a projection of future storage usage.
